//: Story Phase 16: the Beard Contamination Profile. The captain's beard keeps a record of what it has been through: story tags (flags beard_<tag>), shown in the logbook 'The Captain's Beard', read by dialogue and by the hornets. Permanent tags are never removed: the beard is a physical record of the campaign. Not a chemistry system. Story Phase 17: three more tags (Thunderbottom, the Beard Joint with Frog Grog, the Coffin Sock catastrophe), and the beard has started to puff on its own ('puffs': src/world/BeardPuffs.js, while beard_puffing is set). Shaving it is a joke, never a removal.

GARRICK_ORIGINAL.label: Garrick (original)
GARRICK_ORIGINAL.note: The first one. The treasure room. Where it all started (Story Phase 2).

BROGATH_ANCIENT.label: Brogath (ancient)
BROGATH_ANCIENT.note: Ancient Grand Stenchmaster, through cardboard (Story Phase 14).

GRAND_BANK_DEPOSITS.label: Grand Bank deposits
GRAND_BANK_DEPOSITS.note: Every deposit you ever held a sash for, layered (Story Phases 14-15).

SKUNK_HAZE.label: Skunk haze
SKUNK_HAZE.note: The green one, which the beard rejected: why you're the only one who never gets mellow (Story Phase 15).

COFFIN_SOCK.label: Coffin Sock
COFFIN_SOCK.note: Ancient. Dusty. Stale. Musty. Beans. It outranks everything else in there (chapter 188).

VINDICTA_LEGENDARY.label: Vindicta (legendary)
VINDICTA_LEGENDARY.note: A legendary ceremonial release, at point-blank range, while carrying a chicken (chapter 190).

GRAND_LIGHTER_FUEL.label: Grand Lighter fuel
GRAND_LIGHTER_FUEL.note: Thirty-two attempts, one of them right under your chin (chapter 187).

CURRENCY_CONVERTER.label: Currency Converter
CURRENCY_CONVERTER.note: One Grand Token's worth of Coffin Sock, straight from the output horn (chapter 195).

HORNET_ATTRACTED.label: Hornets
HORNET_ATTRACTED.note: They live in it now. STINGBEARD. (It passes.)

THUNDERBOTTOM_LEGENDARY.label: Thunderbottom (legendary)
THUNDERBOTTOM_LEGENDARY.note: Lord Vaporious Thunderbottom the Seventh's grand ceremonial release, absorbed whole while carrying Agnes out of the Fart Zone (chapter 219).

FROG_GROG_FUMES.label: Beard Joint, with Frog Grog
FROG_GROG_FUMES.note: Garrick's improvement on the historic Beard Joint, sneezed back into it by a chicken (chapter 221). The beard has not forgiven anybody.

COFFIN_SOCK_CATASTROPHE.label: Coffin Sock (the catastrophe)
COFFIN_SOCK_CATASTROPHE.note: Brogath's long-brewed Coffin Sock, the big one, caught at chin height (chapter 222). It outranks the first Coffin Sock. It outranks everything.
